data.description:
## Description

**What**: check_dual_identity_complete invariant in invariants.py. For Jira issues with dso-id-* label, verifies dso_local_id property matches (and vice versa). Two failure modes: (a) label present, property missing then differ emits (inbound, repair_property); if repair fails, quarantine + bug ticket. (b) property present, label missing then bug ticket filed same pass. Closes sc-7 negative half.
**Why**: Dual-identity is the safety belt under direction safety — without it, missing property can silently bind two local tickets to one Jira issue or vice versa.
**Scope**:
- IN: invariants.py check_dual_identity_complete, repair_property leaf, quarantine path, same-pass bug filing
- OUT: Schema migration for legacy issues without dual identity (handled by inbound_clean_label sweep)

## Done Definitions

- When a managed Jira issues dso_local_id property is removed mid-pass, check_dual_identity_complete files a bug ticket via .claude/scripts/dso ticket create bug in the same pass; a test against a throwaway DIG issue asserts the bug appears in ticket list --type=bug before the pass exits ← Satisfies: sc-6
- A Jira issue carrying a dso-id-<active-local-id> label but missing the dso_local_id property does NOT bind via JQL dedup to the active local ticket; the differ emits exactly one (inbound, repair_property) mutation on first encounter ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When (inbound, repair_property) fails, the applier removes the orphan label from the Jira issue and files a quarantine bug ticket in the same pass; fault-injection test asserts both the label-removal call and bug-ticket creation ← Satisfies: sc-7
- Given a label-only orphan whose dso-id label references an active local id ALREADY bound to a different Jira key, differ MUST emit (inbound, repair_property) for the orphan and MUST NOT emit any binding mutation that would attach the orphan to the active local id. Unit test: fixture with active binding (local-A and DIG-1) plus orphan (DIG-2 carrying dso-id:local-A label but no property) then manifest contains repair_property for DIG-2, contains no binding mutation against local-A. ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When check_dual_identity_complete quarantines a Jira issue, differ MUST suppress all other mutations targeting that issue in the same passs manifest. Test: fixture where DIG-X is quarantined AND differ would otherwise emit (inbound, update) for DIG-X title change then manifest contains only the quarantine signal + bug-file action, no update mutation. Inverse test: non-quarantined issue with concurrent update emits both. ← Satisfies: sc-6, sc-7
- Unit tests written and passing for all new logic ← Validates Closure Check: "TDD DoD"

## Considerations

- [Security] Filing a bug ticket from inside a reconciler pass requires sandboxing — do not import the full orchestrator into invariants.py; expose a narrow report_schema_drift(issue_key, reason) API instead.
- [Reliability] The invariant must run after fetcher and before applier so that quarantine actions are visible in the same passs manifest.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a reconciler operator, I want check_dual_identity_complete to verify dso-id label and dso_local_id property symmetry with quarantine and same-pass bug filing
